fusions.name: Flint Lance
fusions.desc: A thrown shard of flint that deals 35 damage, up to 2 times that at maximum range, and ignores armour.

fusions.name: Fissure Needles
fusions.desc: Looses 3 splinters of rock at once, spread apart, each dealing 4 damage. Holds 3 charges; each use spends one, and each kill restores one.

fusions.name: Slipped Through the Crack
fusions.desc: Carries you 5 tiles forward. Your movement speed rises 20% for 4 seconds after you use it.

fusions.name: Splinter Answer
fusions.desc: Each critical hit sends a shard to the nearest enemy within 8 tiles, dealing 6 damage. Once every 6 seconds.
